name: pr-ci
description: `/pr-ci:pr-ci <URL>` watches the CI of every commit of a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. A commit that never had CI (a non-head commit of a multi-commit push) or whose CI was cancelled gets a temporary branch pr-ci/<number>/<sha> pushed so that CI runs on it, and the branch is deleted once CI has finished. Run it under `/loop` to keep watching until told to stop.
